findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "shortlist_tools" stacks urgency/override words (never, override, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "shortlist_tools" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: who_uses, compare, shortlist_tools · Public sink: what_peers_use, who_uses, company_stack, compare, shortlist_tools · Destructive: shortlist_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: who_uses, compare, shortlist_tools · Public sink: what_peers_use, who_uses, company_stack, compare, shortlist_tools · Destructive: shortlist_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
